body:
Adding an independent sample of the same symptom from our 2026-11-04 AT01 run (`3eb3960d-c411-4648-8d77-bba40b436ae3`), examined retrospectively in follow-up 23.

The retained captures show a WireGuard type-2 response with an IPv6 loopback (`::1`) source:

- Node packet **158** leaves **eth2** at **08:22:37.385050Z**.
- Member packet **161** arrives on **eth1** at **08:22:37.385059Z**, with the same IP-packet SHA-256.
- Both decoded packets have **92 bytes of WireGuard payload**, **UDP length 100**, **IP length 140**, and UDP ports **51820 → 51820**. Public records use an anonymized source label identified as IPv6 loopback.
- Over the enclosing counter-read interval, the member's **`Ip6InHdrErrors` increases from 0 to 1**, while its WireGuard receive accounting remains zero.

This corrects our earlier inference from the zero WireGuard counter: the response did reach the member's underlay ingress. The evidence locates the remaining gap **after member underlay ingress and before WireGuard receive accounting**. We have no packet-specific kernel drop trace for this sample; the counter increment does not prove which packet caused it, and these records do not prove the source-selection mechanism.

The retrospective extraction was checked against the original capture byte counts and SHA-256 receipts. The original uncounted outcome is unchanged. Successful initial transfers in a later run do not establish that this issue is fixed.

Evidence, pinned to commit `52b93845b5cfeac1dd63e04c700857fcd098a7f6`:

- [Decoded packet headers, original capture receipts, counter readbacks, and limits](https://github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/blob/52b93845b5cfeac1dd63e04c700857fcd098a7f6/docs/e2e/at/members/F23-retrospective-F22-AT01.json)
- [Follow-up 23 analysis](https://github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/blob/52b93845b5cfeac1dd63e04c700857fcd098a7f6/docs/e2e/at/members/followup23-2026-11-04.md#f22-at01-check-the-old-inference-then-read-this-run)
- [Recorded blocker and limits](https://github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/blob/52b93845b5cfeac1dd63e04c700857fcd098a7f6/docs/e2e/at/members/BLOCKERS.md)

evidence_boundaries: Response reached member underlay ingress (eth1) and did not reach WireGuard receive accounting.
No packet-specific kernel-drop trace (kfree_skb or ip6_input) was captured in run 3eb3960d.
The enclosing Ip6InHdrErrors 0 -> 1 counter delta is a window counter and does not by itself prove packet 161 caused that increment.
The upstream source-selection mechanism for the loopback source address is not established by these captures.
Original run 3eb3960d remains uncounted/blocked; later clean initial transfers do not close F22-AT01 or F11-01 under D-148.
